events.title: A small demo update, thanks to your feedback
events.summary: A small update for the Carpet Daddy demo, based on your feedback: A clearer crosshair to help with aiming. Fixes for issues when loading jobs. Controller improvements for smoother movement and easier interactions. A higher completion threshold: carpets now need to be 99.8% clean and almost dry before the completion ding, so it should feel better earned. Thanks to everyone who’s tried the demo and shared feedback. There’s still work to do, but your reports are helping us make it a little better w

events.title: Small demo update — 18 October
events.summary: https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/46269677/d16940e4f58063385e4b819ed1615ba93788e4db.png Pushed a small update to the demo to make it easier for me to analyse errors, especially when a job fails to load. I've also added a bit more detail to the existing optional analytics so I can understand where people get stuck in training. This information is only sent if you've opted in. Thanks for giving the demo a go and for letting me know when something isn't working.

Vacuum, treat stains and extract dirt to turn filthy carpets into satisfying clean stripes. https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/46269677/7a59fc4d24a6f08f372f5df2e6102bbe8e80f665.png What's in the demo?
